$comment: Every booking site that runs this code (Center phase C0). One entry per site: its own Worker, domain, D1, R2 and secrets. Phasakura is the template: its config is the root wrangler.jsonc; every other site's sites/<slug>/wrangler.jsonc is GENERATED from it by `npm run sites:generate` — never edit those by hand. Rate-limit namespace ids are rateLimitBase + 1…4 and must be unique in the Cloudflare account. wave = release order (1 first). docs/SITES.md explains how to add a site.

center.$comment: Center Management console (phase C4): its own Worker and D1; reaches every site through a service binding. center/wrangler.jsonc is GENERATED from this registry.
